name: St Gabriel and the Angels and St John the Baptist, Rochdale
shortName: St Gabriel and the Angels and St John the Baptist

boundary.description: From the point opposite Woodtop Avenue on River Roch (near Bury Road in Broadhalgh), E along River Roch to the point opposite Brigdefield Street, NW to Bury Road, then E by Mellor Street to its junction with Norman Road, and by a bee-line N to the junction of Spotland Road and Mount Street. Then E along Spotland Road to its junction with St Mary’s Gate (A58) and S by a beeline to the roundabout at South Parade. E along South Parade to River Roch. E by the River Roch, to the point opposite Trafalgar Street then S by a beeline to and along Church Road, E by Channing street, S by Moss Bridge Road to Kingsway. The S by Kingsway to and N along Greenfield Lane and W along Rochdale Canal and A627(M) to and S along Rochdale – Oldham District boundary to the Mills Hill – Castleton railway. N along that railway to the Heywood branch, and W along that railway branch, Roeacre Brook and footpath going through Heys Farm, Francil, by the SW boundary of Matthew Mills High School to Rochdale Road East, Bolton Road by a beeline to the River Roch opposite Woodtop Avenue.
